mcqs.question: Which project was approved by the Union Cabinet for Amaravati to accommodate multiple Central Government offices under one roof?
options: Central Government General Pool Office Accommodation Project
Andhra Pradesh State Secretariat Expansion Project
mcqs.explanation: The Union Cabinet approved the Central Government General Pool Office Accommodation Project in Amaravati. Its purpose is to house multiple Central offices under one roof and support the greenfield capital city. The Andhra Pradesh State Secretariat Expansion Project is not the project identified for this approval.
